word: A librarian named Sofía opens the library doors.
answer: Una bibliotecaria llamada Sofía abre las puertas.

word: She lives with passion for books and readers.
answer: Ella vive con pasión por libros y lectores.

word: Sofía writes detailed descriptions of every novel.
answer: Sofía escribe descripciones detalladas de cada novela.

word: Does she receive many letters from grateful readers?
answer: ¿Ella recibe muchas cartas de lectores agradecidos?

word: Yes, she receives heartfelt messages every single week.
answer: Sí, recibe mensajes sinceros cada semana.

word: She decides which books belong in each section.
answer: Ella decide qué libros pertenecen en cada sección.

word: Sofía describes characters as if she knows them.
answer: Sofía describe personajes como si los conoce.

word: She permits students to borrow multiple books freely.
answer: Ella permite que estudiantes tomen libros libremente.

word: Does she admit when she makes catalog mistakes?
answer: ¿Ella admite cuando comete errores de catálogo?

word: Always, she admits errors with honest grace.
answer: Siempre, admite errores con gracia honesta.

word: She attends every community reading event.
answer: Asiste a cada evento de lectura comunitario.

word: Sofía shares her love of reading with everyone.
answer: Sofía comparte su amor de lectura con todos.

word: I open books carefully to protect their pages.
answer: Abro libros cuidadosamente para proteger sus páginas.

word: You live for stories that transport your mind.
answer: Tú vives por historias que transportan tu mente.

word: She writes reviews that help others choose books.
answer: Ella escribe reseñas que ayudan a otros elegir.

word: We receive donations of used books regularly.
answer: Recibimos donaciones de libros usados regularmente.

word: They decide to study literature at university.
answer: Deciden estudiar literatura en la universidad.

word: I describe my favorite book with obvious joy.
answer: Describo mi libro favorito con alegría obvia.

word: Does she permit children to read any book?
answer: ¿Ella permite que niños lean cualquier libro?

word: Yes, she permits reading as a sacred right.
answer: Sí, permite la lectura como un derecho sagrado.

word: We admit that some books change our lives.
answer: Admitimos que algunos libros cambian nuestras vidas.

word: They attend Sofía's book club every Thursday night.
answer: Asisten al club de libros cada jueves.

word: What does the librarian share with her community?
answer: ¿Qué comparte la bibliotecaria con su comunidad?

word: She shares countless stories and infinite wisdom.
answer: Comparte innumerables historias y sabiduría infinita.

word: I open the library with reverence and care.
answer: Abro la biblioteca con reverencia y cuidado.

word: You live in worlds created by brilliant authors.
answer: Tú vives en mundos creados por autores brillantes.

word: She writes letters to thank book donors.
answer: Ella escribe cartas para agradecer donadores.

word: We receive inspiration from every single book.
answer: Recibimos inspiración de cada libro solamente.

word: Sofía decides to leave her library to the community.
answer: Sofía decide dejar su biblioteca a la comunidad.

word: Her legacy opens doors to imagination forever.
answer: Su legado abre puertas a la imaginación siempre.
